{{WorldTableTennisChampionshipsEvents|year=2015}}
{{main article|2015 World Table Tennis Championships}}

The '''2015 World Table Tennis Championships women's doubles''' was the 52nd edition of the women's doubles championship.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.allabouttabletennis.com/world-table-tennis-championships-medal-winners.html|title=List of Winners|publisher=All About Tennis}}</ref><ref name=ITTF>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsWD.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120412045730/http://www.ittf.com/museum/WorldChResultsWD.pdf|url-status=dead|archive-date=2012-04-12|title=Women's doubles results|publisher=International Table Tennis Federation}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://sports123.com/tte/index.html|title=Table Tennis World Championship medal winners|publisher=Sports123|access-date=2018-03-21|archive-date=2018-09-22|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180922055935/http://sports123.com/tte/index.html|url-status=dead}}</ref> [[Guo Yue (table tennis)|Guo Yue]] and [[Li Xiaoxia]] were the defending champions.<ref>[http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_doubles_wttc_web.asp?Gender=W&Tour_ID=2503&Doubles=1 Entry list]</ref>

[[Liu Shiwen]] and [[Zhu Yuling]] won the title by defeating [[Ding Ning]] and [[Li Xiaoxia]] 8–11, 11–8, 3–11, 11–8, 11–13, 11–8, 11–8 in the final.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ittf.com/_front_page/ittf_full_story1.asp?ID=39540&Competition_ID=2503&|title=Reversal of Fortunes for Liu Shiwen, Women's Doubles Title Secured with Zhu Yuling|date=3 May 2015|work=ittf.com}}</ref>

==Seeds==
Matches will be best of 5 games in qualification and best of 7 games in the 64-player sized main draw.<ref>[http://www.ittf.com//World_Events/wttc_2015/Playing%20system_WTTC2015.pdf Playing system]</ref><ref>[http://www.ittf.com/ittf_tournaments/ittf_entries_doubles_wttc_web.asp?Gender=W&Tour_ID=2503&Seeded_Doubles=1&FormParticipants_Sorting=26&FormParticipants_Sorted=& Seeds]</ref>
